issue.title: test_uppercase_g_reaches_detail_bottom flakes under full parallel load
issue.description: Proposed by sase-19x.5 note #4. tests/test_notification_modal_scroll.py::test_uppercase_g_reaches_detail_bottom_from_real_input_path failed once during a loaded full-suite just check, then passed in isolation on the unchanged tree. The phase touched decks block files, not notification-modal scrolling. Investigate the timing or shared-state race; retain the real input-path assertion.

task_type_fields.evidence: One failure under loaded full parallel just check and one focused pass on unchanged tree, reported in sase-19x.5 note #4. Serial recurrence unknown; fail rate unknown beyond that pair.
